policy: These are Noon-authored public examples intentionally limited to the Manim-compatible API surface. They are not copied upstream Manim documentation examples, so they remain separate from the exact-source tutorial manifest.

entries.title: AffineFade
entries.summary: Manim-compatible FadeIn/FadeOut using shift, scale, and target_position.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Blue circle illustrating shifted and scaled fade endpoints

entries.title: FamilyTransformIndicate
entries.summary: Manim-compatible VGroup transform with lag_ratio followed by an Indicate pulse.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Pink square and blue circle with an indicate pulse

entries.title: TimedComposition
entries.summary: Nested Succession with timed Add/Wait steps, then a LaggedStart of FadeOut animations.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Three blue squares illustrating nested timed composition

entries.title: FamilyWrite
entries.summary: Write a styled VGroup with lag_ratio so its members reveal in order.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Styled orange square and pink circle being written as a family

entries.title: SubsetDisplay
entries.summary: ShowIncreasingSubsets followed by ShowSubmobjectsOneByOne on ordered VGroups.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Colored circle rows illustrating increasing and one-by-one subset display
